skill.name: lark-okr
skill.description: Use Lark OKR commands to view cycles, inspect objectives and key results, and manage OKR alignments and metrics.
skill.summary: Manage Lark OKR cycles, objectives, key results, alignments, and progress metrics through lark-cli.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: Static analysis produced many hits, but review found sample URLs, Markdown links, Markdown backticks, and OKR key-result terminology rather than malware. The remaining risk is operational: authenticated lark-cli write and delete operations can alter Lark OKR business records.

remediation.issue: Write and delete OKR operations can change business records.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit instructions to require user confirmation before create, patch, delete, reorder, or weight-change commands.

remediation.issue: Shared setup guidance is referenced through an adjacent relative path.
remediation.suggestion: Declare lark-shared as a reviewed dependency or inline the required authentication and permission guidance.

static_findings.snippet: > **前置条件:** 先阅读 [`lark-shared/SKILL.md`](../../lark-shared/SKILL.md) 了解认证、全局参数和安全规则。
- [lark-okr](../SKILL.md) -- 所有 OKR 命令(shortcut 和 API 接口)
| `--cycle-id <id>` | 是  | —      | OKR 周期 ID(int64 类型)。从 `+cycle-list` 获取。 |
> **前置条件:** 先阅读 [`lark-shared/SKILL.md`](../../lark-shared/SKILL.md) 了解认证、全局参数和安全规则。
| `--user-id <id>`        | 是  | —         | OKR 所有者的用户 ID
在 OKR 系统中,default/normal 状态下的周期当前正常生效,invalid 状态下的周期已失效但通常仍然可以填写,hidden 状态下的周期隐藏不可见。
> - `objective.key_results.list` — 获取目标下的关键结果列表
> - `objectives.key_results_position` — 更新目标下的关键结果排序
> - `objectives.key_results_weight` — 更新目标下的关键结果权重
**CRITICAL — 开始前 MUST 先用 Read 工具读取 [`../lark-shared/SKILL.md`](../lark-shared/SKILL.md),其中包含认证、权限处理*
Shortcut 是对常用操作的高级封装(`lark-cli okr +<verb> [flags]`)。有 Shortcut 的操作优先使用。
| [`+cycle-list`](references/lark-okr-cycle-list.md)     | 获取特定用户的 OKR 周期列表,可以按时间筛选 |
| [`+cycle-detail`](references/lark-okr-cycle-detail.md) | 获取特定 OKR 中所有目标和关键结果的内容   |
- [`ContentBlock 富文本格式`](references/lark-okr-contentblock.md) — Objective/KeyResult/Notes 字段使用的富文本格式
- [`OKR 业务实体`](references/lark-okr-entities.md) 获取 OKR 实体结构,定义和关系,帮助你更好的使用 OKR 功能
- **强烈建议** 在操作 OKR 前,阅读[`OKR 业务实体`](references/lark-okr-entities.md)以了解基础概念
> **重要**:使用原生 API 时,**必须**先运行 `schema` 查看 `--data` / `--params` 参数结构,**不要**猜测字段格式!
- `objectives_position` — 更新用户周期下全部目标的位置
- `objectives_weight` — 更新用户周期下全部目标的权重
- `list` — 批量获取用户周期下的目标
- `list` — 获取关键结果的量化指标
- `key_results_position` — 更新全部关键结果的位置
- `key_results_weight` — 更新全部关键结果的权重
- `list` — 批量获取目标下的对齐关系
- `list` — 批量获取目标下的关键结果
**CRITICAL — 开始前 MUST 先用 Read 工具读取 [`../lark-shared/SKILL.md`](../lark-shared/SKILL.md),其中包含认证、权限处理*

semantic_findings.title: Destructive OKR Operations Require Confirmation
semantic_findings.description: The skill documents create, patch, delete, reorder, and weight update methods for Lark OKR records. These are legitimate capabilities, but unattended use could alter or delete business data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Multiple documented methods delete or modify OKR records and require write scopes. The risk is operational rather than malicious because the actions use authenticated Lark APIs.

content.value_statement: Teams need accurate OKR updates without guessing Lark API fields. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Lark OKR workflows.
actual_capabilities: Lists Lark OKR cycles for a specified user with optional time filters.
Retrieves objectives and key results for a selected OKR cycle.
Explains OKR entities, fields, statuses, scopes, and relationships.
Documents ContentBlock formatting for objective, key result, and note fields.
Guides native lark-cli OKR API calls after checking schema requirements.
Identifies required Lark permission scopes for read and write operations.
limitations: Requires lark-cli, Lark authentication, and authorized OKR scopes.
Does not provide credentials or bypass tenant permissions.
Write operations can change business data and need review before execution.
Entity IDs must come from Lark or earlier commands.

use_cases.title: Review Team OKR Cycles
use_cases.description: Find active or historical OKR cycles for a user and summarize dates, status, and cycle IDs.

use_cases.title: Inspect Objective Progress
use_cases.description: Retrieve a cycle detail and summarize objectives, key results, scores, weights, and deadlines.

use_cases.title: Prepare Safe OKR Updates
use_cases.description: Check schema and permission requirements before creating, patching, deleting, or reordering OKR records.

prompt_templates.title: List My OKR Cycles
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Lark OKR skill to list my OKR cycles. Resolve my user ID first if needed, then summarize the active cycles.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Cycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Use cycle ID 1234567890123456789 to get the OKR cycle detail. Summarize each objective, key result, score, weight, and deadline.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Objective Update
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to update an OKR objective. Check the lark-cli schema first, identify required fields and scopes, then propose the command for review.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Alignment and Metrics
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this cycle for objective alignments and indicator progress. Identify missing metrics, risky statuses, and safe lark-cli commands to correct them.

output_examples.input: List OKR cycles for a user in 2025 Q1 and Q2.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports matching cycles, date ranges, statuses, and cycle IDs. It notes which cycle fits detailed review.

output_examples.input: Show details for one OKR cycle.
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes objectives, key results, owners, deadlines, scores, and weights in plain language.

output_examples.input: Prepare to update a key result progress metric.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks the schema, identifies needed indicator fields, lists scopes, and asks for confirmation before any write operation.

best_practices: Run schema checks before native API commands so field formats are not guessed.
Use dry-run or review planned commands before write or delete operations.
Confirm user IDs, cycle IDs, and permission scopes before changing OKR data.
anti_patterns: Do not run write or delete commands without a clear user request and confirmation.
Do not guess ContentBlock JSON or OKR entity IDs from names alone.
Do not use broad tenant credentials when a user-scoped token is enough.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Lark OKR cycles, objectives, key results, alignments, categories, and progress indicators through lark-cli commands.

faq.question: Does it require lark-cli?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill depends on lark-cli and valid Lark authentication before it can access OKR data.

faq.question: Can it edit OKRs?
faq.answer: Yes, if the authenticated account has write scopes. Review commands before creating, patching, deleting, or reordering records.

faq.question: Can it find my user ID?
faq.answer: It can guide the assistant to resolve a user ID through related Lark contact commands when available.

faq.question: Does it expose secrets?
faq.answer: No evidence of embedded secrets was found. Authenticated Lark credentials should still remain scoped and protected.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
